notes.title: Halloween!
notes.content: 1- Made a few minor changes for Halloween.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
1- Added a few changes in general.

2- The fog in the game has been reduced.

3- Fixed were made in the last part.

4- Fixed some animations.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
1- The doll scene has changed.

2- Made a few animation fixes.

3- Added several sounds to the game.

4- After the game is over, Teddy greets us instead of a doll.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
1- Added extra animation to the first map.

2- Puzzles made easy.

3- Final map made easier.

4- Little fixes have been made.

notes.title: Multiple-Language
notes.content:
[b]English:[/b]
Turkish language support has been added to the game.

We continue to work on other languages.

[b]Turkish:[/b]
Oyuna Türkçe dil desteği eklendi.

Diğer diller üzerinde çalışmaya devam ediyoruz.
